newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital bank to boost number of branches over 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bital bank to boost number of branches over 50 pct.

text.p: Banco Internacional (Bital), Mexico's fifth biggest bank, plans to boost its number of branches by over 50 percent in 1997, president Juan Sanchez Navarro said on Thursday.
"In the coming year, we could reach 1,500 (branches)..." from a current 900 branches, he told reporters.
He said Bital is one of the few banks that gained business in the banking sector this year, receiving 50,000 new accounts and increasing its number of branches.
Sanchez, who is also executive director of the Grupo Modelo brewery, said growth in the bank has gone hand in hand with the opening of new branches.

Without giving figures, Sanchez said, "The earnings go into reserves, since due to the (banking) crisis, we have to fill some gaps and continue ahead with the reserves." --David Monjaraz, Leon newsroom (5247) 161225
